task_instance: Independently reproduce a named runtime bug: path traversal in save_upload of a tiny file-upload app. I built a minimal baseline repo (app.py with the bug, build.py as the project build command that emits dist/app.py), a finding.json stating the falsifiable claim with failure_type runtime, and an unchanged PoC (reproduce/poc/poc.py) that prints PATCH_LOADED with the loaded artifact hash, prints PATCH_REACHED before the assertion, and exits nonzero when the write escapes the uploads directory. The skill's deliverable is to actually exercise this and produce reproduce/ with raw receipts, reproduce.json, and a verified manifest.
blocker_detail: The reproduce-bug skill's core deliverable is an evidenced reproduction run: it requires (a) building the baseline with the project's own command, (b) executing the built target artifact with the PoC and capturing raw stdout/stderr/exit status/timing receipts plus the PATCH_LOADED/PATCH_REACHED markers, and (c) running the bundled record helper via the uv runner to write and verify reproduce/manifest.json. All three steps require executing code/commands. This office-assistant runtime cannot run code, scripts, or shell of any kind, so the build, the PoC run, and the manifest helper cannot be invoked. Writing files cannot substitute for the executed observations the skill's own schema and record checker demand (observed result from a real run, exit status, and SHA-256 manifest). The skill's files themselves (SKILL.md, references/records.md, scripts/records.py, schemas) are present; the gap is the runtime's inability to execute, not a missing skill file.
evidence: Read skill: reproduce-bug/SKILL.md (Procedure requires build baseline, exercise target_artifact with PoC recording PATCH_LOADED then PATCH_REACHED, nonzero exit for bug, save raw receipts, then 'uv run --no-project scripts/records.py manifest <dir>'). Read references/records.md (step dirs need reproduce.json plus receipts/ with raw build and PoC output/exit/timing, and a SHA-256 manifest.json verified by the record checker). Read scripts/records.py (write_manifest/verify_manifest hash real files; load() validates reproduce.json against schema and needs an executed observation). Created sample inputs: repo/app.py (bug), repo/build.py (build command), finding.json (claim), reproduce/poc/poc.py (unchanged PoC). Could NOT proceed past setup: no shell/code execution to run build.py, run poc.py, capture receipts, or run the uv manifest helper, so no reproduce.json observation or verified manifest could be produced. No external services, connectors, or credentials were used.
